prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original portrait loading illustration for Into the Abyss, a mobile fantasy dungeon RPG. Create one vertical 2:3 illustration, ideally 768x1152, with NO typography or interface. Scene: the ruined upper corridors of an old magical academy, fractured stone arches and worn lecture-room doors, a descending stair opening beyond the central arch, a few scattered closed books and a broken mundane brass scholarly instrument. The setting should feel like an abandoned place of learning, not a church, palace or hellscape. No humans or characters, no creatures. Style: restrained hand-painted fantasy environment with deliberate graphic shapes, etched material detail, subtle coarse painted grain; readable at phone size, not photorealistic. Composition: main arch and descending route occupy middle 55%; top 18% is quiet dark stone shadow for separate HTML title; bottom 24% is quiet near-black foreground for separate HTML loading text and bar. Real architectural perspective, clear silhouette, modest scene scale. Palette: gunmetal #151A1B, stone gray #545B56, faded brass #B6A075, off-white muted ambient daylight. A small natural daylight opening beyond the arch, no supernatural glow. No ornate framing, no runes, no glowing magic circles, no purple-blue gradient, no particles, no interface panels, no progress bars, no text, no letters, no logos, no watermark. This is original environmental concept art, not a copy of any other game's image.
